an4.11:1.1: Carato ce pibhikkhave bhikkhuno uppajjatikāmavitakko vā vyāpādavitakko vā vihiṃsāvitakko vā,
an4.11:1.2: tañ ce bhikkhu adhivāseti nappajahati na vinodeti na vyantikaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti,
an4.11:1.3: carañ ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃbhūto anātāpī anottāpī satataṃ samitan kusīto hīnaviriyo ti vuccati.
an4.11:2.1: Ṭhitassa ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhuno uppajjati kāmavitakko vā . . . vihiṃsāvitakko vā,
an4.11:2.2: tañ ce bhikkhu adhivāseti . . . na anabhāvaṃ gameti,
an4.11:2.3: ṭhito ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃbhūto anātāpī anottāpī satataṃ samitaṃ kusīto hīnaviriyo ti vuccati.
an4.11:3.1: Nisinnassa ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhuno uppajjati kāmavitakko vā . . . vihiṃsāvitakko vā,
an4.11:3.2: tañ ce bhikkhu adhivāseti . . . na anabhāvaṃ gameti,
an4.11:3.3: nisinno ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃbhūto anātāpī anottāpī satataṃ samitaṃ kusīto hīnaviriyo ti vuccati.
an4.11:4.1: Sayānassa ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhuno Jāgarassa uppajjati kāmavitakko vā . . . vihiṃsāvitakko vā,
an4.11:4.2: tañ ce bhikkhu adhivāseti . . . na anabhāvaṃ gameti,
an4.11:4.3: sayāno pi bhikkhave bhikkhu jāgaro pi evaṃbhūto anātāpī . . . hīnaviriyo ti vuccati. 2.
an4.11:5.1: Carato ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhuno uppajjatti kāmavitakko vā . . . vihiṃsāvitakko vā,
an4.11:5.2: tañ ce bhikkhu nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti vyantikaroti anabhāvam gameti,
an4.11:5.3: carañ ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃbhūto ātāpī ottāpī satataṃ samitaṃ āraddhaviriyo pahitatto ti vuccati.
an4.11:8.1: Sayānassa ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhuno jāgarassa uppajjati kāmavitakko vā . . . vihiṃsā-vitakko vā,
an4.11:8.2: tañ ce bhikkhu nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti vyantikaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti,
an4.11:8.3: sayāno pi bhikkhave bhikkhu jāgaro pi evaṃbhūto ātāpī ottāpī satataṃ samitaṃ āraddhaviriyo pahitatto ti vuccati
an4.11:11.1: Yo ca caraṃ vā tiṭṭhaṃ vā
